metric_frame: fixed Phase5 global normalized MIN, no clipping
spacing: sample SD ddof1 of Euclidean nearest other neighbor distance; corrected V1 applied outputs verified
sparsity: mean Euclidean nearest other neighbor distance; lower indicates density, not universal quality
gd_igd: arithmetic mean Euclidean nearest target distances, p1
hv_reference_rule: lower=min(0,all_candidate_min); ref=max(1.1,all_candidate_max+.05*max(all_candidate_max-lower,1)), elementwise; preserved corrected V1 rule

hv_quadrature.rng: PCG64 via explicit scipy rng=Generator; distinct from legacy seed=RandomState interface
hv_quadrature.change_reason: same HV integral and historical reference rule; four times the dyadic nodes per scramble versus old power14, common nodes for every set and paired sensitivity
hv_quadrature.error_reporting: mean across4 scrambles and sample SD/sqrt4; no exact HV claim

reference_subsampling_rule: 100 distinct sorted subsets of r seed indices without replacement; one generator consumed in ascending r; same subset for both EA families; r30 singleton; prefixes secondary
reference_final: frozen Phase7 P_minus_CNBI,18503 ND, empirical not ground truth
reference_retained_in_benchmark: complete P_all or complete family LOO, never R_K
baseline: frozen Phase7 CNBI5 pool408 from Phase6 H20 membership
farthest: objective extrema first in objective order; dedup repeated extreme indices; then largest minimum squared Euclidean distance; exact ties lowest stable archived source-row ID; one complete ordering per set
K_max_rule: minimum genuine unique-ND cardinality across CNBI5 and all60 stochastic runs, not average
numerical_equality: unchanged frozen Phase6 x dedup and z dominance vector; cached pair graph reproduces subset-specific first representatives and ND

timing.primary_cost: processing end-to-end wall time; never artificial NFE equivalence
timing.configuration: exact Phase7 EA scientific configuration, no tuning
timing.execution: same hardware/Python/env/commit, single numerical thread, methods sequential, no concurrent science jobs
timing.warmup: one unreported run of each EA at frozen config, seed1000
timing.callback: read-only snapshots/ND; no RNG calls or evolution changes, metrics after measured campaign
timing.CNBI_user_decision: preserve408 and finish Phase8B quality; report CNBI cost pending, no attribution of direct H5 runtime

statistics: no pseudo-replication deterministic methods; native30 EA runs, deterministic single fronts; strict better fractions and score-oriented midrank percentile; no inferential p tests
